t: You're on Upper Grosvenor Street, a one-way Georgian street in Mayfair. It runs from beside the Grosvenor House Hotel to the London Chancery Building. Prince William Frederick, Duke of Gloucester and Edinburgh, nephew and son-in-law of George the Third, lived here. So did the businessman Samuel Morley, later Baron Hollenden. Meresia Nevill, a leading advocate of the Conservative Primrose League, was born on this street.
